settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Make Campus OS work for your school.
settings.generalDescription: The essentials for your school workspace.
settings.appearanceDescription: A comfortable workspace, in every light.
settings.regionDescription: Your language, dates, and local conventions.
settings.notificationsDescription: Choose what you want to hear about.
settings.profileDescription: Your name and face, across your workspace.
settings.schoolDescription: The details that make this workspace yours.
settings.securityDescription: Understand access and protect your school’s information.
settings.aiDescription: Connect intelligence. Keep control of your data.
settings.darkHint: Easy on the eyes after hours.
settings.themeHint: Theme changes apply immediately across the application.
settings.absenceHint: When a student is marked absent.
settings.lostHint: When a lost belonging is reported.
settings.foundHint: When a found item is added to the register.
settings.claimedHint: When an item is successfully collected.
settings.notificationsHint: Preferences apply to new notifications. The activity log always records changes.
settings.avatarHint: PNG, JPG, or JPEG. Resized to a small, local avatar.
settings.profileHint: Your username and demo login stay unchanged when you edit your profile.
settings.schoolHint: Your school name and logo appear in the sidebar.
settings.securityWarning: The temporary login is a client-side demonstration, not secure authentication. Anyone with the source can discover the credentials. Do not deploy this login to protect real student information.
settings.passwordLocked: The temporary credentials are fixed in this version. Connect server-verified authentication before enabling password changes.
settings.checkAuth: Replace demo login with server-verified authentication.
settings.checkRls: Apply database permissions and row-level security.
settings.checkStorage: Move school records to an access-controlled database.
settings.checkPrivacy: Review your school’s privacy and retention policies.
settings.storageHint: Data is not encrypted by this app and is not synced between devices. Clear browser data only after making a backup.
settings.backupHint: Download your records, settings, and chats. Keep the file private.
settings.enableAIHint: Show the assistant in your workspace navigation.
settings.serverKey: API keys stay on the server. Never enter a secret key here.
settings.aggregatesHint: Read-only counts and rates. Always minimized; no names or student IDs.
settings.demographicsHint: Only if collected and authorized. Never individual records.
settings.itemSummariesHint: Item names, categories, and locations only. No reporter details.
settings.activitySummariesHint: Action counts only. No administrator or student names.
settings.saveHistoryHint: Personal identifiers are removed before messages are stored or sent.
settings.clearHistoryDescription: This permanently removes all Campus AI conversations from this browser. School records are not affected.
ai.title: Campus AI
ai.subtitle: Your intelligent school administration assistant.
ai.eyebrow: A little intelligence. A lot more clarity.
ai.deleteChatDescription: This conversation will be permanently removed from this device.
ai.disclaimer: Campus AI can make mistakes. Verify important information. Read-only access.
ai.promptAbsent: How many students are absent today?
ai.promptClasses: Which class has the highest absence rate?
ai.promptItems: How many items are currently unclaimed?
ai.notConnectedTitle: Connect Campus AI to get started
ai.notConnected: Real AI replies require a server-side Gemini key plus either a verified administrator sign-in or the private demo access code. No simulated answers are generated.
ai.disabledDescription: Enable the assistant in AI settings. Local search and measured reports remain available.
ai.setupGemini: Set GEMINI_API_KEY and GEMINI_MODEL in Vercel.
ai.setupAuth: Set CAMPUS_AI_DEMO_CODE for a private demo, or connect Supabase Auth to verify the administrator role server-side.
ai.dataHint: Counts are calculated locally. Only enabled, minimized summaries can be sent to Gemini.
ai.redacted: Personal identifiers were removed. Use local search for individual student records.
ai.requestError: Your message could not be answered. No school records were changed.
ai.error.provider_not_configured: Gemini is not configured. Add GEMINI_API_KEY and GEMINI_MODEL to the server environment.
ai.error.auth_not_configured: Secure access is not configured on the server. Set CAMPUS_AI_DEMO_CODE for a private demo, or set up Supabase Auth.
ai.error.unauthorized: Access was not verified. Enter the private demo access code, or sign in with a verified administrator account. The temporary admin login alone cannot authorize the AI backend.
ai.error.invalid_api_key: The Gemini API key was rejected. Replace it in the server environment.
ai.error.quota_exceeded: The Gemini quota has been reached. Check your provider billing or try again later.
ai.error.network_error: The AI provider could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
ai.error.invalid_response: The provider returned an invalid or empty response. Please try again.
ai.error.server_error: The AI service encountered an error. Please try again later.
ai.error.request_too_large: This request is too large. Start a new conversation or shorten your message.
ai.error.invalid_request: The request could not be validated. Please try a shorter message.
ai.error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute before trying again.
ai.error.ai_disabled: Campus AI is disabled in your settings.
ai.error.provider_error: The provider could not complete this request. Try again later.
ai.historyOff: History saving is off. This conversation is temporary.
reports.subtitle: Export measured statistics from your actual school records.

reports.activitySummary: {{total}} administrative actions were recorded during this period.
reports.observationRate: The attendance rate is {{rate}}% of recorded entries. {{unrecorded}} active student-days in the selected range have no record.
reports.observationClasses: {{count}} classes have attendance records in this period.
reports.conclusionText: Use these figures alongside your school’s records. Missing attendance entries are excluded from attendance-rate calculations.
reports.noData: There are no records for this report yet. Add real school records, then generate it again.
reports.generated: Report generated from your current data.
